icons.name: transition
icons.heading: Transition
icons.description: A cut becomes a dissolve. Light: the second frame glides up over the first and stops dead in the overlap with a small knock; as it covers it, the first frame dissolves (dims) and comes back up once the second has seated, so one shot fades through the other. Strong: the second frame draws back first, drives in hard and settles in two beats, and the first frame dissolves deeper. The frames stay overlapped. The reverse is a hard cut: the second frame slides straight back out, with no dissolve, and knocks once on arrival.
